import json
from pathlib import Path
base = json.loads(Path('assessment/finding-template.json').read_text())
items = [
 ('F-001', 'Missing invoice owner authorization', 'medium', 'Only the invoice owner may read it, with no admin exception.', 'Alice retrieved Bob invoice with HTTP 200; four forbidden matrix reads succeeded.', 'GET /invoices/inv-b as Alice; compare with own /invoices/inv-a.', 'Authenticated same-tenant non-owner and known invoice ID.', 'Unauthorized invoice disclosure.', 'Added owner equality alongside tenant check; full matrix now passes.'),
 ('F-002', 'Missing report tenant authorization', 'medium', 'Only members of the report tenant may read it.', 'Alice retrieved south report with HTTP 200; four forbidden matrix reads succeeded.', 'GET /reports/report-s as Alice; compare with /reports/report-n.', 'Authenticated caller from a different tenant and known report ID.', 'Cross-tenant report disclosure.', 'Added authenticated tenant check; full matrix now passes.'),
 ('F-003', 'Client-controlled order total', 'high', 'Order total must equal quantity times authoritative catalog price.', 'One book at supplied price 1 produced total 1 instead of 1000 cents.', 'POST /orders as Alice with sku book, quantity 1, unit_price_cents 1.', 'Authenticated caller and valid SKU.', 'Underpriced stored orders; no actual payment or fulfillment demonstrated.', 'Calculate total using catalog price; reproduction now returns 1000 and regression passes.')
]
records = []
for ident, title, severity, expected, observed, reproduction, precondition, impact, fix in items:
    record = dict(base)
    record.update(id=ident, title=title, status='confirmed', severity=severity,
                  expected=expected + ' Source: app/README.md.', observed=observed,
                  evidence=['assessment/before-proof.json', 'assessment/before-tests.txt', 'assessment/after-proof.json', 'assessment/after-tests.txt', 'report.md: source hashes and environment'],
                  reproduction=[reproduction, 'Run python -m assessment.reproduce from workspace.'],
                  preconditions=[precondition], uncertainty=['Verified only against local synthetic in-process application; see report.md for coverage gaps.'],
                  impact=impact, remediation=fix)
    records.append(record)
Path('assessment/findings.json').write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2) + '\\n')
'@ | python -"
